notes: Ran HQ 4x on T2 instead of checking the freshly installed Server 2 card that became Project Yagi-Uda (scored T3), and spent T3-T4 doing nothing but R&D runs with no setup. Clicked for credits at 13-23 credits on T13-T15 and T17 with nothing to spend on, then on T19-T22 ran Server 3 into the known unbreakable Anemone six times and jacked out each time, losing Revolver and other cards to net damage for nothing. Ignored the new Server 6 on T22, and the Corp won by scoring Yagi-Uda from it on T23.

Opened with no economy, so HQ (behind only Drafter) gave up Project Ingatan and Megaprix T1, and the Corp sat at 0-2 credits through T2-T6. Installed and advanced Megaprix Qualifier on T9 behind just Drafter (no ETR), and it was stolen. From T10 on it used the Ansel 1.0 remote well (Méliès, Ingatan, Superconducting Hub, Megaprix all scored with Seamless Launch), and Vertigo's no-steal clause covered HQ.

After a Sure Gamble on T2 it never installed or played another card, clicking for credits every turn from T2 to T18 and finishing on 72 credits with a full grip. Made single programless facechecks into Envelopment (T13), Tree Line (T14) and Akhet (T15) and never contested the remotes where Transport Monopoly and three Above the Laws were scored. On T1 it took a tag from Privileged Access and then paid 2 to remove it.

Solid HB play: Ansel 1.0 on R&D, campaigns for economy, and a strong T10 Wage Workers/Otto click turn followed by Seamless Launch scores of Megaprix, Méliès, Architect Deployment Test and Megaprix. The main slip was installing and double-advancing Superconducting Hub on T9 behind two Vertigos (no ETR), and it was stolen.

Good pressure with Revolver and Carpe Diem on R&D (steals on T3, T4 and T8), and it finished by breaking Hafrún with Shibboleth to steal Longevity Serum from Server 1. The T3 facecheck into Karunā cost 4 cards, and on T9 and T10 it used Red Team clicks to run Archives and immediately jack out for no gain.

Let Drafter install Architect Deployment Test into a naked Server 1 on T1, advanced it once on T2 without icing it, and it was stolen on T2 (Megaprix also fell from a weak HQ). Clicked for credits on T3 while holding agendas, and on T5 had 11 credits but did not rez the ice protecting Project Ingatan in Server 2, which was stolen.

Efficient: Buzzsaw plus double Strike Fund on T1, cheap repeated R&D runs through Afshar, Banner to get through Akhet, and Leech traded to steal SDS Drone Deployment from HQ on T5, winning T7. It ran low on credits and spent some clicks on basic credits, but there were no real mistakes.

Never installed or played a single card all game, holding 5 cards and clicking for credits from T4 to T14 up to 38 credits. Did not run the 1-advanced Server 3 card on T5 while the Corp had 3 credits (Divested Trust was scored T6), and made programless facechecks into Descent (T1, T12) and Akhet (T10). Never ran HQ once while the Corp scored Above the Law twice.

Repeatedly paid 2 credits and a click to trash Stoneship Chart Room (T3, T4, T5, T8 twice, T9, T12 twice) while broke, which kept it at 0-3 credits all game. Never built a scoring remote, so Next Big Thing sat in HQ and was stolen T6, and it never rezzed the R&D ice that the Runner walked through every turn. Ended turns clicking for credits and discarding from a full hand (T9, T10, T12).

Won by repeatedly scoring Embedded Reporting and Tomorrow's Headline out of a Server 1 protected only by Ping, which worked because the Runner went passive. Economy hovered at 0-4 with clicks for credits and end-of-turn discards on T8-T11, HQ ice was never rezzed (Next Big Thing stolen T3, Post-Truth Dividend T11), and the Embedded Reporting installed T6 sat lightly iced until T9.

Clean NBN plan: Next Big Thing scored T3 behind Ping, Post-Truth Dividend fast-advanced T5, then Federal Fundraising plus Mestnichestvo/Grubber remotes to score Tomorrow's Headline (T10) and Embedded Reporting (T15). The oddities were a T11 Next Big Thing use that shuffled its entire 7-card hand away and several thin click-for-credit turns at 2-4 credits (T6, T12-T13).

Good start (T1 R&D steal, Boi-tatá and Banner set up, Divested Trust stolen from Server 1 T5) and a Leech/Banner R&D finish for SDS Drone Deployment on T17. In between it ran Server 2 into the same unbroken Descent six times (T5-T8, T10, T13), which taxed the Corp 2 credits each time but never got in, and it spent turns like T4, T9 and T12 clicking for credits while R&D was barely defended.

Put Tomorrow's Headline in Server 1 on T2 behind only Paywall and Virtual Service Agent, and it was stolen immediately. Then it spent all its money paying 2 per click to trash Stoneship Chart Room three times on T4 and again on T5, and Daily Casts on T11, T12 and T14, leaving it at 0-5 credits with end-of-turn discards nearly every turn (T5, T8-T13, T15). It eventually scored 5 points from Server 1, but Post-Truth Dividend was stolen T17 and R&D was never secured.

Ran HQ 8 times on T2-T3 seeing the same 3-4 cards while ignoring the advancing Server 2 card (Regenesis, scored T4). Made three repeat HQ runs on T12 with nothing new to see. On T13, having already seen Prāna Condenser in HQ, it ran into Karunā unbroken three times, jacking out each time, which gave the Corp 9 credits and Condenser counters and cut its grip to 1, then lost to the foreseeable Prāna Condenser flatline on T14.

Strong HQ pressure with Shibboleth and Docklands Pass: two Hybrid Releases T2, Yagi-Uda via Transfer of Wealth T3, and Fujii Asset Retrieval on T9 for the win, with Jailbreak and Tread Lightly used well. Minor inefficiencies were a few redundant draw/credit clicks and a second HQ run on T8 that saw Saisentan again.

Built a three-ice Server 3 and never installed anything in it. From T5 to T12 it clicked for credits up to 28, discarding from a full hand, while every agenda sat in HQ behind a single Vertigo (no ETR). The Runner took Project Ingatan (T5), two Megaprix Qualifiers (T13) and Superconducting Hub (T15) from HQ while the Corp never tried to score.

Did not check the new Server 1 card on T3 (Above the Law scored T4), and spent T6 and T12 drawing and clicking for credits at 12-14 credits. On T13 the Corp was on 4 points with only 3 credits and a 2-advanced card in Server 1, but the Runner clicked for credits and installed Fencer Fueno and Mystic Maemi instead of running, and SDS Drone Deployment scored for the win on T14.

Stacked three ice on an empty Server 1 and never put anything in it, while holding agendas in HQ behind one Hagen. The R&D ice was never rezzed even at 10-17 credits, so the Runner walked in every turn. Clicked for credits with a full hand on T5, T9 (discard) and T10, and lost Superconducting Hub (T6) and Méliès (T9) from HQ plus Megaprix and Architect Deployment Test from R&D.

Rezzed Ansel 1.0 on T1 in front of Project Ingatan and kept scoring out of that remote (Ingatan T3, Méliès T8 with Seamless Launch, Ingatan T10), and the Runner could never steal past it. Economy sat at 0-1 credits for most of the game, which would have been fragile against a breaker, but it was a coherent plan.

Played only Sure Gamble and clicked for credits from T3 to T15, reaching 55 credits with nothing installed. Ignored scoring remotes the Corp advanced in front of it (Server 1 T1, Server 2 T10), and after walking through Ballista into Server 3 to steal Transport Monopoly on T12, it never ran Server 3 again on T13 or T15 while Transport Monopoly and the winning Divested Trust were advanced there. Its few runs were programless facechecks into Tree Line (T4) and Akhet (T7).
